text:
talia: emergency hotfix v2.5.0 for routing header regression causing retries and 503s in EU. targeting 02:15-02:45 UTC window. requesting expedited approval to skip canary; customer impact ongoing. details: https://confluence/release/v2.5.0 (root)
infra-bot: Preflight: unit tests + smoke ok. Canary-skip requires two release:approve.
harper: what's the rollback plan if errors rise?
talia: rollback = pin to last-good sha 0a1b2c; traffic cut to 0%; no migrations. auto-rollback if 3m error rate > 2%. cmds below.
talia: ```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-router router=image:0a1b2c -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 7123456789 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
ryan: eu-west1 has spare capacity, i'll monitor. +1.
harper: +1. will watch latency and 5xx.
deploybot: Approval count: 3 (talia, ryan, harper). Initiating rollout in 1m. logs: https://deploylogs/7123456789
deploybot: Phase 1 (20%) -> OK. Phase 2 (60%) -> OK. Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. No elevated errors observed.
ryan: sanity probe: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X GET https://api.eu1.redwood/health` -> 200
harper: kv/routing metrics look stable, closing rollout. tagging support to publish a short note. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: Emergency v2.5.0 routing header hotfix in EU: infra-bot preflight OK. Expedited skip-canary approvals obtained (talia, ryan, harper). Rollout phased and successful; rollback plan pinned to sha 0a1b2c if thresholds exceeded; support to publish release note.
